text: Native vector search, with a vector property defined in the schema
quote: Being a vector database, Orama allows you to perform vector search natively.

text: Hybrid search combines full-text and vector search in a single query
quote: Hybrid search is an Orama feature that allows you to perform full-text and vector search in one unique query, combining the results to get the best of both worlds.

text: Full-text search engine for adding search to your own app
quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.

text: Embeddings plugin generates vectors at insert and search time without exposing the OpenAI API key on the front end
quote: This plugin generates embeddings for your documents at insert and search time, allowing you to perform vector and hybrid searches on your documents.

text: Orama Cloud automatically generates text embeddings for your data using local models
quote: Orama Cloud generates text embeddings automatically for your data using local, high-quality models.

text: Choose a collection's language and its embedding model when creating it
quote: When you create a collection, you can choose its language (English, Spanish, etc.), and the embedding model you want to use.

text: AnswerSession provides ChatGPT-like conversational answers on your website
quote: With Orama 3.0, we introduced a new feature called AnswerSession that allows you to perform ChatGPT-like experiences on your website.

text: Secure Proxy forwards queries to the OpenAI API so the API key isn't exposed client-side
quote: AnswerSession** that allows you to perform ChatGPT-like experiences on your website. It uses a free feature from Orama Cloud called **Secure Proxy** to proxy your queries to the OpenAI API, so you don't need to worry about sharing the API k

text: Turns a question into a direct answer and cites the sources behind it
quote: turns a question into a straight answer with the sources behind it

text: AnswerSession state-change events let you update the UI reactively
quote: The onStateChange: console.log event will log the state of the session, allowing you to reactively update your UI based on the current state of the session.

text: Projects group data sources for use in RAG, search, or other retrieval
quote: A project is a set of **data sources** that you want to use for RAG, search, or any other method of retrieval.

text: Every Orama Cloud project includes an auto-configured MCP server for its data
quote: Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.

text: Connect a Cloud project to MCP-capable AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Cursor via the MCP server URL
quote: By copying the MCP Server URL, you can easily connect your Orama Cloud project to various AI assistants that support the MCP protocol.

text: On-premise deployment of the Orama Cloud context server on your own infrastructure
quote: We offer on-premise support for Orama Cloud, allowing you to deploy the context server on your own infrastructure.

text: Deployment in your cloud, on-prem, or dedicated, operated with forward-deployed engineers
quote: It runs in your cloud, on-prem, or dedicated, and our forward-deployed engineers run it with your team.

text: Orama Cloud lets you choose the search algorithm that fits your needs
quote: Orama Cloud gives you the flexibility to choose the search algorithm that best suits your needs.

text: Data sources are segregated, so you can update or delete one without affecting the others
quote: Every data source is segregated from the others, so you can update, delete, or add new data without affecting the data in the other data sources.

text: Separate data sources can follow different update schedules
quote: you can put data that will be updated frequently in a single data source (let's call it `docs`), and put data that follows a different update schedule in another data source

text: Open-source search library, free to use in your application
quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.

text: Open-source APIs mirror the Cloud APIs, allowing migration in either direction
quote: The APIs are designed to be as close as possible to the Orama Cloud APIs, so you can easily migrate your projects from Orama Cloud to Orama Open Source and vice-versa.

text: Official Cloud SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Rust
quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust

text: Stemming and tokenization in 30 languages

text: Native support for nested properties in documents

text: Create a database instance from an indexing schema that defines searchable properties
quote: We can create a new instance (from now on database) with an indexing schema. The schema represents the searchable properties of the document to be inserted.

Schema can tolerate missing or undefined fields and ignore extra fields

quote: If you have a lot of records, we suggest using the insertMultiple function... You can pass a third, optional, parameter to change the batch size (default: 1000).
